ai_summary: The Anup Engineering Limited reported a mixed H1 FY27, demonstrating a strong sequential recovery in Q2 with revenue up 46% QoQ and significantly improved profitability, yet experiencing substantial year-over-year declines in both revenue and PAT (down 88%). This material impact was driven by elevated raw material costs due to geopolitical tensions and under-absorption of fixed costs from lower volumes. While a healthy ₹941 crore order book and strategic expansion into thermal power and clean energy sectors provide future growth visibility, a potential red flag is the balance sheet showing net short-term borrowings, contradicting a "net debt free company" claim in the annexures.
